'''Kaid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Kaid was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and was leading a squad of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Melicoste]]'s commandos on a mission to extract [[Darth Ekkage]] from [[Belsavis prison]]. However, Kaid and the commandos were attacked by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] in [[Melicoste's bunker]]. Kaid, upon being threatened, revealed to the Wrath that Melicoste already left ahead for the [[High Security Section]]. The Wrath then killed Kaid after saying he outlived his usefulness.<ref name="Strong" />
